acceptance: Density presets, command palette and navigation choices are reversible without reauthorizing source operations.

positive.fixture: density presets, navigation and palette choices switch and restore

negative.fixture: layout and palette changes never authorize a source operation or dispatch

security_and_source_permissions: Preferences change presentation only; palette runs commands only from trusted events and shows their effect class.
performance_memory_storage: Palette opens in about 98 ms median with 1,000 rows (bench/ui.json).
known_limitations: Preferences are per page session; persistence is a later batch
